# Heavy / campaign tools — A100 strongly recommended; free T4 = small fallback only.
# Install on Colab (Pro/A100) in the sessions that actually run the models. Pin what you used.
# These PRODUCE the metrics the shared filter scores; the filter itself needs none of them.
#   BindCraft        https://github.com/martinpacesa/BindCraft       # one-shot binder hallucination (A100). Pin a commit.
#   FreeBindCraft    https://github.com/cytokineking/FreeBindCraft    # free-tier fallback (VERIFY it still exists). Pin a commit.
#   RFdiffusion      https://github.com/RosettaCommons/RFdiffusion    # binder mode (A100 for 500-1000 backbones). Pin a commit.
#   LigandMPNN       https://github.com/dauparas/LigandMPNN           # Zn-AWARE sequence design near the di-zinc site (NOT vanilla ProteinMPNN). Pin a commit.
#   ColabDesign      https://github.com/sokrypton/ColabDesign         # RFdiffusion-binder protocol. Pin a commit.
#   ColabFold        https://github.com/sokrypton/ColabFold           # AF2-Multimer (pae_interaction). Pin a commit.
# Optional stretch:
#   boltz            # Boltz-2 affinity on top hits (scaffold only — relative ranking + caveats, never a fabricated K_D/IC50). Pin the version.
#   pyrosetta        # interface energy (rosetta_dG) / shape complementarity — academic license; FreeBindCraft avoids it. Pin the release.
#   AutoDock-Vina    https://github.com/ccsb-scripps/AutoDock-Vina    # OPTIONAL carbapenem docking for the occlusion analysis (notebook 04). Pin a release.
#
# NOTE: these tools change fast. The version-verify cell (00_setup / 02) HTTP-checks the pinned URLs
